# Issue 83139: the module is on a v1 pseudo-version above its latest
# compatible release v1.0.0, which has a go.mod file. Upgrades must stay on
# the v1 line and must not select v2.0.0+incompatible.

go get example.com/upgradeincompat@v1.0.1-0.20220404040404-dddddddddddd
go list -m -u example.com/upgradeincompat
stdout '^example.com/upgradeincompat v1.0.1-0.20220404040404-dddddddddddd$'

go get -u example.com/upgradeincompat
go list -m example.com/upgradeincompat
stdout '^example.com/upgradeincompat v1.0.1-0.20220404040404-dddddddddddd$'

go get example.com/upgradeincompat@upgrade
go list -m example.com/upgradeincompat
stdout '^example.com/upgradeincompat v1.0.1-0.20220404040404-dddddddddddd$'

go list -m -u example.com/upgradeincompat
stdout '^example.com/upgradeincompat v1.0.1-0.20220404040404-dddddddddddd$'

-- go.mod --
module x

go 1.12
